title: HelperSessionClearBoundary
description: One sighted erase-saved-lines (nocx-2v80t.3.17), sent on the same ordered carrier as the rows and the interval end markers, in the position it occurred: a consumer that reads this plane in order can never attribute it to the wrong side of a row. Unlike session.output-rows and session.interval-end it carries no row index and no cursor of its own — the coordinator resolves what the boundary bounds from the session id alone (content.RecordClearBoundary), because the erase is a real VT fact the emulator's own state already reflects (ADR-0066) rather than something authenticated elsewhere that this frame only locates. `kind` is a closed discriminator, reserved so a later boundary kind (nocx-zg3k3.10.3's own scrollback paging) fits the same shape without widening this one.

kind.description: What kind of boundary this is. 'clear' is the only member today: the program erased the display and its saved lines.
